headline: Steady growth across segments; adjusted earnings climb
summary_short: Marsh's Q3 2026 revenue was $6.86B (+8% y/y, +5% underlying); GAAP EPS was $1.69 and adjusted EPS rose 10% to $2.03.
summary_long: Risk revenue rose 10% (5% underlying) while Reinsurance revenue fell 6%. Consulting revenue grew 9%, with Management Consulting up 14% and People and Investments up 5% underlying. GAAP operating income rose 4% to $1.2B; adjusted operating income rose 6% to $1.5B. Marsh repurchased 2.7 million shares for $500M in the quarter and repaid 550 million euros of notes. The CEO said the Thrive program is progressing and the brand transition is complete. No numeric guidance was given.
confidence_notes: The company renamed from Marsh McLennan to Marsh effective January 14, 2026; segment names in the release reflect the rebrand. Underlying growth is the company's own measure. Adjusted figures exclude noteworthy items and identified intangible amortization.

drivers.explanation: Risk grew 5% underlying and Management Consulting 14%, while Reinsurance revenue fell 6%.
Consulting operating income rose 12%, while Risk and Insurance Services operating income fell 1%.
CEO cited market position, client value and progress on the Thrive program.
